review_candidates.title: Lead, Systems Engineer (Platform Engineering)
review_candidates.description: L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do. L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security. Job Title: Lead Systems Engineer (Platform Engineering) Job Code: 42610 Job Location: Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA Job Schedule: 9/80 (Every Other Friday Off) Job Description: As the premier provider of Space Domain Awareness (SDA) mission solutions for the United States Space Force, L3Harris is seeking a Lead Systems Engineer/Platform Engineer to perform system sustainment functions related to the MOSSAIC C2 Space Domain Awareness (SDA) mission at Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA. The ideal candidate will be responsible for monitoring and maintaining the performance of our Space Mission Platform and its tenant applications. This role is critical in ensuring that our systems operate at peak efficiency and are secure from internal and external threats. Essential Functions: Lead monitoring and maintenance of the operational platform and tenant applications to ensure high availability and strong system performance. Oversee troubleshooting and resolution of system issues, outages, and performance concerns, ensuring timely response and minimal downtime. Provide technical leadership for system sustainment activities and support daily mission operations. Guide end-user support efforts, helping resolve complex issues and promoting system best practices. Lead the planning and implementation of system upgrades, enhancements, patches, and service packs. Conduct and oversee routine system audits to evaluate system performance, integrity, and compliance. Develop, improve, and maintain system documentation, technical procedures, and standard operating procedures. Coordinate with site support teams, administrators, engineers, and mission stakeholders to resolve issues and improve system operations. Review system alerts, incidents, and operational trends, and drive corrective and preventive actions. Prepare performance reports, assess system health, and provide recommendations for improvements and modernization. Ensure compliance with ITAR, EAR, and CUI requirements, along with company policies and cybersecurity standards. Maintain awareness of emerging technologies, industry trends, and engineering best practices that may improve system performance and mission support. Support team development by mentoring junior engineers and administrators. Travel up to 10% as needed. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 9 years of related experience, or a graduate degree with at least 7 years of related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience. Active U.S. DoD Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain a Top-Secret clearance. Strong experience with system performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and sustainment in an operational environment. Strong understanding of network infrastructure, system administration, and data processing pipelines. Demonstrated ability to lead technical activities and support cross-functional engineering efforts. Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and attention to detail. Preferred Additional Skills: Experience designing, deploying, and administering VMware Cloud Foundation. Excellent communication, collaboration, and documentation skills. Ability to work independently, lead multiple priorities, and operate effectively in a mission-focused environment. Experience administering VMware vSphere. Experience administering Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP. Experience administering Windows Server and Red Hat Enterprise Linux. DoD 8570.01M IAT Level 2 certification, such as CompTIA Security+ CE. Willingness to participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation. Experience administering Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle database systems. Understanding of Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms. Additional certifications such as Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA), Network+, or VMware, Microsoft, or other relevant infrastructure and systems certifications. Experience mentoring junior technical staff and leading system improvement initiatives. In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role in California is $127,500-$236,500. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. L3Harris also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements. L3Harris Technologies is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. L3Harris is committed to treating all employees and applicants for employment with respect and dignity and maintaining a workplace that is free from unlawful discrimination. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or other related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, characteristic or membership in any other group protected by federal, state or local laws. L3Harris maintains a drug-free workplace and performs pre-employment substance abuse testing and background checks, where permitted by law. Please be aware many of our positions require the ability to obtain a security clearance. Security clearances may only be granted to U.S. citizens. In addition, applicants who accept a conditional offer of employment may be subject to government security investigation(s) and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. By submitting your resume for this position, you understand and agree that L3Harris Technologies may share your resume, as well as any other related personal information or documentation you provide, with its subsidiaries and affiliated companies for the purpose of considering you for other available positions. L3Harris Technologies is an E-Verify Employer. Please click here for the E-Verify Poster in English or Spanish. For information regarding your Right To Work, please click here for English or Spanish.

architecture including topology diagrams, IP addressing schemes, and network segmentation plans Develop comprehensive network design documentation including technical specifications, implementation plans, and configuration standards Create detailed network architecture blueprints that incorporate security, redundancy, and scalability requirements Design solutions that optimize network performance, reliability, and security Plan for present and future capacity requirements through capacity modeling and forecasting Manage and expand network interconnections, network co-location sites, and points of presence Manage network infrastructure and deployments to Top Secret datacenters Improve network performance and reliability based upon system performance metrics Assist in capacity augmentation and network optimization deployments Lead network integration and troubleshooting efforts across complex environments Collaborate with hardware, software, and network engineers security requirements Conduct performance testing and optimization to meet service level agreements Technical Expertise & Maintenance: Maintain technical expertise in all areas of network and computer hardware and software interconnection and interfacing Demonstrate proficiency with routers, switches, firewalls, hubs, bridges, gateways, and related networking equipment Stay current with networking technologies, protocols, and industry best practices Maintain deep knowledge of OSI model and Layers 1-4 functionality Apply expertise in virtualization and security practices including IPSec, Radius/TACACS+, and 802.1x Understand and implement network security measures including IDS, ACLs, and IPSEC tunnels Compliance & Security: Ensure compliance with DISA STIG Checklist and other security standards Implement network security best practices and maintain security posture Configure and maintain network access controls and authentication mechanisms Support security audits and vulnerability assessments Maintain documentation to support certification and accreditation activities Apply security patches and updates in accordance with organizational policies What We Are Looking For 5 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 3 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; 0 years experience with PhD or Juris Doctorate in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years relevant experience. Complete understanding and wide application of technical principles, theories, and concepts in the networking field. General knowledge of other related disciplines including cybersecurity, systems administration, and cloud computing. Expert knowledge of networking protocols (TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EIGRP, spanning tree, VLANs, etc.). Proficiency in network design principles and architecture frameworks. Deep understanding of OSI model and protocol stack interactions. Knowledge of network security principles, technologies, and best practices. Familiarity with virtualization technologies and software-defined networking. Understanding of disaster recovery and business continuity planning for networks. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for complex network issues. Ability to translate business requirements into technical network solutions. Strategic thinking to align network architecture with organizational objectives. Excellent troubleshooting and diagnostic capabilities. Clearance: Must posses and maintain a TS/SCI clearance and obtain/maintain additional clearance or accesses required by specific customer requirements. Must be able to obtain and maintain a TESA approval. Preferred: Bonus Points For... Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or related field plus 5 years of relevant experience, OR Master's degree in related field plus 3 years of relevant experience, OR High School Diploma or equivalent plus 9 years of relevant experience. Industry certifications such as JNCIA-Junos, JNCIS-ENT, JNCIP-ENT, or JNCIE-ENT. Additional certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent. 2-4 years of hands-on network engineering experience, including configuring and supporting Juniper hardware. Experience with Department of Defense network environments and security requirements. Background working with Top Secret systems and secure network infrastructure. Familiarity with government compliance frameworks and standards. Physical Requirements May require working in an office, industrial, shipboard, or laboratory environment. Responsibilities: Engineer and architect Data Center, Cloud, and LAN/WAN networking solutions. Configuration and deployment of both on premise and cloud-based networking technologies. Responsible for the network domain as part of our DR strategy. Wide area network design, deployments, and administration of MPLS, DIA, and SDWAN. review_candidates.title: Principal Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description: Building trusted markets — powered by our people At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world. We’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities. To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model. Location Overview Cboe HQ is located in the historic Old Post Office district, it’s a landmark that blends classic architecture with modern amenities. The building features expansive spaces with high ceilings and large windows, offering an abundance of natural light and panoramic views of the city skyline and the Chicago River. With its prime location in the heart of downtown, the OPO Building provides easy access to major transportation hubs, including Union Station and multiple CTA lines, making it convenient for commuters. The building is home to a variety of amenities, including restaurants, a fitness center, and collaborative workspaces, creating a vibrant and dynamic work environment in one of Chicago's most iconic areas. Role Overview Cboe Global Markets is seeking a Principal Network Engineer to serve as a deep technical anchor for our global network infrastructure. This role is responsible for shaping the design, scalability, and long-term evolution of highly distributed, latency-sensitive trading networks across on-prem and cloud environments. The Principal Engineer brings expert-level knowledge of deterministic packet forwarding, advanced routing design, and ultra-low latency architecture, combined with the ability to operate independently and own complex problems end-to-end. This individual partners closely with Network Engineering leadership and cross-functional architecture teams to lead high-complexity initiatives, conduct rigorous pre-implementation testing and validation, and establish best practices that drive consistency and reliability across the environment. They function as a technical leader without formal authority—mentoring senior engineers, influencing design decisions, and raising the overall engineering bar across the organization. Success in this role requires both deep technical expertise and strong communication skills. The Principal Engineer must be able to translate complex architectural decisions, trade-offs, and risks into clear, actionable insights for both engineering teams and senior leadership. The ideal candidate holds (or is actively pursuing) a CCIE certification, writes production-quality Python, and is comfortable working with modern observability platforms such as Prometheus and Grafana to drive data-informed engineering decisions. Your responsibilities will be: Design and evolve low-latency, highly resilient network architecture across global data center, co-location, and cloud-connected environments, with a focus on deterministic packet forwarding, scalability, and operational consistency Lead advanced routing design and implementation across complex global environments, including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, multicast, hybrid cloud connectivity, traffic engineering, and high-availability network patterns Conduct deep technical research, lab validation, and pre-implementation testing for major network initiatives, working closely with engineering and software development teams to evaluate hardware capabilities, identify design constraints, and optimize exchange performance based on findings Lead high-complexity strategic projects from design through execution, producing detailed technical designs, migration runbooks, capacity plans, and implementation guidance for large-scale network changes Develop and maintain Python-based network automation to support configuration management, change validation, testing, and operational efficiency, with direct experience using both API-driven and SSH-based automation approaches Partner across infrastructure, security, application, and business teams to align network design and delivery with technical requirements, operational goals, and broader organizational priorities, including support for budgeting and planning related to network hardware and software investments Serve as a senior technical leader and mentor across the engineering organization, driving architecture reviews, design standards, knowledge sharing, and technical development for other engineers Operate effectively in a fast-moving, dynamic environment where priorities can shift, balancing long-term architectural direction with immediate engineering and operational needs Contribute to monitoring and telemetry strategy by helping define meaningful visibility requirements and supporting the use of tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms where they improve operational insight and troubleshooting Support the development of technical standards, design documentation, and regulatory or audit-facing materials when needed, including documentation that may be used to support SEC or other regulatory review processes The ideal candidate has 10+ years of hands-on network engineering experience in mission-critical, low-latency environments, with a strong track record operating and evolving high-performance network infrastructure Deep expertise in low-latency and deterministic network design, including practical experience analyzing latency, jitter, and end-to-end traffic behavior in production environments Advanced knowledge of routing protocols at scale, including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, and multicast (PIM-SM/SSM), with proven experience designing resilient, highly available global networks Strong understanding of network hardware and platform capabilities across major vendors, with the ability to evaluate limitations and optimize design decisions through hands-on research and lab validation review_candidates.title: Network Engineering Architect, Director
review_candidates.description: About This Role Network Engineering Architect (Director) Overview of Technology roles: At BlackRock, technology is at the heart of our mission to help people build better financial futures. We foster a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, where technologists work across teams and regions to solve complex challenges. You’ll find an environment that encourages continuous learning, cross-functional teamwork, and the freedom to experiment – all while building systems that support a leading global financial institution. About this role: The Network Engineering Architect (Director) is a senior technical leader responsible for defining BlackRock’s enterprise network architecture strategy and driving its successful implementation across the firm. This hands-on role combines visionary architecture leadership with deep technical expertise to modernize our global network, making it more automated, resilient, and secure . You will influence network technology decisions at the highest levels and ensure our network infrastructure evolves to meet BlackRock’s business needs in an innovative yet risk-aware manner. Role Overview: In this role, you will set the north-star architecture for a complex global network spanning on-premises and cloud environments. You will lead architecture governance forums and design reviews, establishing reference patterns and standards that guide teams worldwide. Partnering closely with cybersecurity, platform engineering, site reliability engineering (SRE), and application development teams, you will ensure network designs integrate smoothly with security requirements and application needs. A key focus will be transforming traditional networking into “network-as-code” – leveraging automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and even AI-driven tools to make network changes safe, auditable, and routine . As a player-coach, you’ll mentor senior network engineers and architects, promoting best practices and a culture of continuous improvement. Ultimately, you will help BlackRock achieve a secure, high-performance, and agile network foundation that empowers our business and developers. What Makes This Opportunity Unique Strategic Impact at Global Scale: Shape the network architecture of a top-tier global financial institution, directly influencing how our infrastructure supports millions of clients and mission-critical services around the world. Intersection of Network & Cutting-Edge Tech: Drive the convergence of networking with automation and AI, moving from traditional manual processes to a programmable, intelligent network that sets new standards for speed and reliability. Innovator’s Canvas: Lead a modernization journey that turns complex network systems into a developer-friendly platform – enabling self-service capabilities, reducing risk through automation, and accelerating innovation across the firm. Mission-Forward Environment: Work in a highly regulated, security-focused environment where resilience, performance, and integrity are paramount – giving you the opportunity to architect solutions that truly matter for the firm’s success. Leadership & Growth: Join a dynamic technology organization that values executive leadership and hands-on expertise in equal measure, offering a platform to influence senior stakeholders, mentor a global team of technologists, and be at the forefront of BlackRock’s continued transformation. Key Responsibilities Define and evolve the enterprise network architecture strategy and multi-year roadmap, ensuring alignment with business goals, security requirements, and emerging technology opportunities. Establish and enforce network architecture standards, reference patterns, and design principles for core network domains (e.g., data center, campus, WAN, cloud connectivity), balancing innovation with operational stability. Lead architecture governance and design reviews: chair architecture boards or forums to evaluate key network designs, ensuring solutions are scalable, resilient, compliant, and aligned with BlackRock’s risk controls. Champion an Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation-first approach to networking – implement declarative network configuration, CI/CD pipelines, and version control for network changes to improve agility and consistency. Implement robust change management processes that make safe, auditable network changes routine – including automated testing, validation, and traceability for every network configuration update with built-in human approval checkpoints. Design and advocate for identity-based network segmentation and policy frameworks (e.g., label or identity-driven routing) to enhance security and flexibility, enabling dynamic, intent-based traffic management across our environments. Develop self-service networking capabilities: create templates, APIs, guardrails, and “paved path” abstractions that allow application teams and non-network specialists to safely consume network services and deploy network changes with confidence. Integrate AI-driven tools and workflows into network engineering: pioneer the use of AI-assisted configuration (e.g. large language model-based assistants) and agent-based automation to streamline network planning and change implementation. Leverage AI/ML for network analytics and optimization: apply machine learning techniques to analyze network configurations and real-time telemetry, identifying opportunities to improve performance, capacity, and resilience. Ensure all AI-driven decisions integrate sensible human-in-the-loop oversight, transparency, and auditability. Ensure robust core network design and performance: Oversee the architecture of routing, switching, load balancing, DNS, and connectivity solutions, delivering highly available and resilient networks (including modern overlay/underlay design) across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. review_candidates.title: Talent strategist
review_candidates.description: At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Shape our talent strategy. Define and improve how we hire, navigate the trade-offs that determine where effort and investment create the most value, and ensure that hiring remains a competitive advantage for Bending Spoons. Continuously experiment and improve. Challenge assumptions, run rigorous experiments, and use evidence to identify better ways to attract, assess, and hire outstanding people. Own hiring end-to-end. Run the full recruiting loop—from sourcing to final decision—using AI and modern tooling to accelerate the process while applying human judgment where it matters most. Find exceptional talent. Proactively identify and engage top candidates across multiple channels, combining outreach, data, and new technologies to surface the strongest people. Build high-signal evaluations. Design and run structured assessments—tests, interviews, and other evaluation methods—that produce clear signal and support confident hiring decisions. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £56,345 to £85,797 in London and from €54,346 to €82,557 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £196,764 in London or €188,848 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time. Location Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries. The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here. We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times. We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form. Before you apply If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again. Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment. To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage. If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

review_candidates.title: Senior GPU Networking Architect
review_candidates.description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. We are looking for a Senior GPU Networking Architect to join our networking software group, bringing strong GPU architecture and programming skills to build and improve GPU communication kernels. This role links GPU computing with networking by making sure communication primitives are carefully developed alongside GPU hardware capabilities. Join our team of engineers developing the software foundation for the largest AI systems globally. What You Will Be Doing Build, implement, and optimize GPU communication kernels that underpin collective and point-to-point operations in large-scale AI systems. Leverage deep knowledge of GPU architecture—thread scheduling, memory hierarchy, execution pipelines—to improve kernel efficiency, minimize latency, and overlap computation with communication. Develop GPU-resident communication primitives and device-side APIs that enable fine-grained, kernel-initiated data movement across nodes and accelerators. Profile and tune GPU kernels end-to-end, identifying bottlenecks at the intersection of compute, memory, and network, and driving targeted optimizations. Collaborate with network software, hardware, and AI framework teams to co-design communication strategies that align with GPU execution patterns and emerging model architectures. Build proofs-of-concept, conduct experiments, and perform quantitative modeling to evaluate and validate new communication strategies before committing them to production. Contribute to the evolution of programming models that expose GPU-aware networking capabilities to application developers. What We Need To See 5+ years of hands-on CUDA programming, including writing and optimizing non-trivial GPU kernels. M.Sc. or equivalent experience in computer science, computer engineering, or a closely related field. Strong understanding of GPU architecture fundamentals: warp scheduling, shared memory, L2 cache, memory coalescing, occupancy tuning, and asynchronous execution. Experience with systems-level C/C++ development in performance-critical environments. Familiarity with GPU data movement mechanisms such as GPUDirect RDMA and GPU-initiated communication. Ability to read and reason about GPU performance profiles (e.g., Nsight Compute, Nsight Systems) and translate observations into actionable optimizations. Strong collaboration skills in a multi-national, interdisciplinary environment. Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd Experience developing or optimizing communication kernels in libraries such as NCCL, NVSHMEM, or similar GPU-aware communication frameworks. Understanding of distributed deep learning parallelism techniques, including data parallelism, tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, expert parallelism, and mixture-of-experts parallelism, and the communication patterns they impose on GPU kernels. Background in RDMA, InfiniBand, high-speed networking, and GPU system topology, including NVLink, NVSwitch, PCIe, and network fabrics, and their impact on communication kernel design. Experience with overlap techniques such as kernel pipelining, persistent kernels, or cooperative groups to hide communication latency behind compute. Proven experience evaluating and optimizing large-scale LLM training or inference workloads, including hands-on work with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorRT-LLM, or vLLM, and familiarity with emerging serving architectures such as disaggregated serving. At NVIDIA, you'll work alongside colleagues who demonstrate deep expertise and innovative thinking in the industry, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in AI and high-performance computing. If you're passionate about GPU architecture, low-level kernel optimization, and building the communication fabric for next-generation AI, we want to hear from you! Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/ Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. For Poland: The base salary range is 292,500 PLN - 507,000 PLN for Level 4, and 375,000 PLN - 650,000 PLN for Level 5. , , JR2015083

Manual machining, machine operation, or related machine shop experience. Basic electrical knowledge, including troubleshooting and fault-finding skills. Thermal spray experience. Industrial mechanical and fitter experience. Military experience related to electrical systems, troubleshooting, mechanical repair, or maintenance. The opportunity to travel internationally and gain experience working with customers across the globe. Comprehensive training and development programmes to help you build specialist skills in a highly specialised and in-demand field. Career growth opportunities within a global industry leader. 24 days of annual leave. A contributory pension scheme. The opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals in a supportive, team-oriented environment. We provide full training and support to help you succeed. As this role involves international travel and physically demanding work, successful candidates will be required to complete occupational medical assessments and receive any necessary immunisations for global travel. If you're looking for a hands-on technical career with global travel, specialist training, and the opportunity to work with industry-leading equipment, we'd love to hear from you!

We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. Location Overview Cboe HQ is located in the historic Old Post Office district, it’s a landmark that blends classic architecture with modern amenities. The building features expansive spaces with high ceilings and large windows, offering an abundance of natural light and panoramic views of the city skyline and the Chicago River. With its prime location in the heart of downtown, the OPO Building provides easy access to major transportation hubs, including Union Station and multiple CTA lines, making it convenient for commuters. The building is home to a variety of amenities, including restaurants, a fitness center, and collaborative workspaces, creating a vibrant and dynamic work environment in one of Chicago's most iconic areas. Role Overview Cboe Global Markets is seeking a Principal Network Engineer to serve as a deep technical anchor for our global network infrastructure. This role is responsible for shaping the design, scalability, and long-term evolution of highly distributed, latency-sensitive trading networks across on-prem and cloud environments. The Principal Engineer brings expert-level knowledge of deterministic packet forwarding, advanced routing design, and ultra-low latency architecture, combined with the ability to operate independently and own complex problems end-to-end. This individual partners closely with Network Engineering leadership and cross-functional architecture teams to lead high-complexity initiatives, conduct rigorous pre-implementation testing and validation, and establish best practices that drive consistency and reliability across the environment. They function as a technical leader without formal authority—mentoring senior engineers, influencing design decisions, and raising the overall engineering bar across the organization. Success in this role requires both deep technical expertise and strong communication skills. The Principal Engineer must be able to translate complex architectural decisions, trade-offs, and risks into clear, actionable insights for both engineering teams and senior leadership. The ideal candidate holds (or is actively pursuing) a CCIE certification, writes production-quality Python, and is comfortable working with modern observability platforms such as Prometheus and Grafana to drive data-informed engineering decisions. Your responsibilities will be: Design and evolve low-latency, highly resilient network architecture across global data center, co-location, and cloud-connected environments, with a focus on deterministic packet forwarding, scalability, and operational consistency Lead advanced routing design and implementation across complex global environments, including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, multicast, hybrid cloud connectivity, traffic engineering, and high-availability network patterns Conduct deep technical research, lab validation, and pre-implementation testing for major network initiatives, working closely with engineering and software development teams to evaluate hardware capabilities, identify design constraints, and optimize exchange performance based on findings Lead high-complexity strategic projects from design through execution, producing detailed technical designs, migration runbooks, capacity plans, and implementation guidance for large-scale network changes Develop and maintain Python-based network automation to support configuration management, change validation, testing, and operational efficiency, with direct experience using both API-driven and SSH-based automation approaches Partner across infrastructure, security, application, and business teams to align network design and delivery with technical requirements, operational goals, and broader organizational priorities, including support for budgeting and planning related to network hardware and software investments Serve as a senior technical leader and mentor across the engineering organization, driving architecture reviews, design standards, knowledge sharing, and technical development for other engineers Operate effectively in a fast-moving, dynamic environment where priorities can shift, balancing long-term architectural direction with immediate engineering and operational needs Contribute to monitoring and telemetry strategy by helping define meaningful visibility requirements and supporting the use of tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms where they improve operational insight and troubleshooting Support the development of technical standards, design documentation, and regulatory or audit-facing materials when needed, including documentation that may be used to support SEC or other regulatory review processes The ideal candidate has 10+ years of hands-on network engineering experience in mission-critical, low-latency environments, with a strong track record operating and evolving high-performance network infrastructure Deep expertise in low-latency and deterministic network design, including practical experience analyzing latency, jitter, and end-to-end traffic behavior in production environments Advanced knowledge of routing protocols at scale, including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, and multicast (PIM-SM/SSM), with proven experience designing resilient, highly available global networks Strong understanding of network hardware and platform capabilities across major vendors, with the ability to evaluate limitations and optimize design decisions through hands-on research and lab validation Experience designing and supporting hybrid cloud connectivity, including AWS networking constructs such as Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPCs, and route integration Proven experience building and maintaining Python-based network automation, including API-driven and SSH-based approaches for configuration management, testing, and operational efficiency Working knowledge of observability and telemetry concepts, with exposure to platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, or similar tools for network visibility and performance analysis Strong background in leading technical research, proof-of-concept validation, and pre-implementation design for large-scale network initiatives Solid understanding of network security fundamentals, including segmentation, access control, and zero-trust principles as they apply to network design Experience operating in fast-paced, highly dynamic environments, with the ability to adapt to changing priorities while maintaining a strong focus on execution and delivery Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, influence technical direction, and contribute to engineering standards and best practices across an organization Experience contributing to technical documentation, design standards, or materials supporting regulatory or audit processes is a plus Preferred certifications: Cisco CCIE (Routing & Switching or Data Center) or near-equivalent experience AWS Advanced Networking Specialty or similar Arista, Juniper, or other advanced vendor certifications Benefits And Perks Of Working For Cboe Global Markets We value the total wellbeing of our people – including health, financial, personal and social wellness. We believe standard benefits like health insurance and fair pay are a given at any organization. Still, you should know we offer: Fair and competitive salary and incentive compensation packages with an upside for overachievement Generous paid time off, including vacation, personal days, sick days and annual community service days Health, dental and vision benefits, including access to telemedicine and mental health services 2:1 401(k) match, up to 8% match immediately upon hire Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan Tax Savings Accounts for health, dependent and transportation Employee referral bonus program Volunteer opportunities to help you give back to your communities Some of our associates’ favorite benefits and perks include: Complimentary lunch, snacks and coffee in any Cboe office Paid Tuition assistance and education opportunities Generous charitable giving company match Paid parental leave and fertility benefits On-site gyms and discounts to other fitness centers Paid Time Off This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. new_matches.title: Network Engineering Architect, Director
new_matches.description: About This Role Network Engineering Architect (Director) Overview of Technology roles: At BlackRock, technology is at the heart of our mission to help people build better financial futures. We foster a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, where technologists work across teams and regions to solve complex challenges. You’ll find an environment that encourages continuous learning, cross-functional teamwork, and the freedom to experiment – all while building systems that support a leading global financial institution. About this role: The Network Engineering Architect (Director) is a senior technical leader responsible for defining BlackRock’s enterprise network architecture strategy and driving its successful implementation across the firm. This hands-on role combines visionary architecture leadership with deep technical expertise to modernize our global network, making it more automated, resilient, and secure . You will influence network technology decisions at the highest levels and ensure our network infrastructure evolves to meet BlackRock’s business needs in an innovative yet risk-aware manner. Role Overview: In this role, you will set the north-star architecture for a complex global network spanning on-premises and cloud environments. You will lead architecture governance forums and design reviews, establishing reference patterns and standards that guide teams worldwide. Partnering closely with cybersecurity, platform engineering, site reliability engineering (SRE), and application development teams, you will ensure network designs integrate smoothly with security requirements and application needs. A key focus will be transforming traditional networking into “network-as-code” – leveraging automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and even AI-driven tools to make network changes safe, auditable, and routine . As a player-coach, you’ll mentor senior network engineers and architects, promoting best practices and a culture of continuous improvement. Ultimately, you will help BlackRock achieve a secure, high-performance, and agile network foundation that empowers our business and developers. What Makes This Opportunity Unique Strategic Impact at Global Scale: Shape the network architecture of a top-tier global financial institution, directly influencing how our infrastructure supports millions of clients and mission-critical services around the world. Intersection of Network & Cutting-Edge Tech: Drive the convergence of networking with automation and AI, moving from traditional manual processes to a programmable, intelligent network that sets new standards for speed and reliability. Innovator’s Canvas: Lead a modernization journey that turns complex network systems into a developer-friendly platform – enabling self-service capabilities, reducing risk through automation, and accelerating innovation across the firm. Mission-Forward Environment: Work in a highly regulated, security-focused environment where resilience, performance, and integrity are paramount – giving you the opportunity to architect solutions that truly matter for the firm’s success. Leadership & Growth: Join a dynamic technology organization that values executive leadership and hands-on expertise in equal measure, offering a platform to influence senior stakeholders, mentor a global team of technologists, and be at the forefront of BlackRock’s continued transformation. Key Responsibilities Define and evolve the enterprise network architecture strategy and multi-year roadmap, ensuring alignment with business goals, security requirements, and emerging technology opportunities. Establish and enforce network architecture standards, reference patterns, and design principles for core network domains (e.g., data center, campus, WAN, cloud connectivity), balancing innovation with operational stability. Lead architecture governance and design reviews: chair architecture boards or forums to evaluate key network designs, ensuring solutions are scalable, resilient, compliant, and aligned with BlackRock’s risk controls. Champion an Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation-first approach to networking – implement declarative network configuration, CI/CD pipelines, and version control for network changes to improve agility and consistency. Implement robust change management processes that make safe, auditable network changes routine – including automated testing, validation, and traceability for every network configuration update with built-in human approval checkpoints. Design and advocate for identity-based network segmentation and policy frameworks (e.g., label or identity-driven routing) to enhance security and flexibility, enabling dynamic, intent-based traffic management across our environments. Develop self-service networking capabilities: create templates, APIs, guardrails, and “paved path” abstractions that allow application teams and non-network specialists to safely consume network services and deploy network changes with confidence. Integrate AI-driven tools and workflows into network engineering: pioneer the use of AI-assisted configuration (e.g. large language model-based assistants) and agent-based automation to streamline network planning and change implementation. Leverage AI/ML for network analytics and optimization: apply machine learning techniques to analyze network configurations and real-time telemetry, identifying opportunities to improve performance, capacity, and resilience. Ensure all AI-driven decisions integrate sensible human-in-the-loop oversight, transparency, and auditability. Ensure robust core network design and performance: Oversee the architecture of routing, switching, load balancing, DNS, and connectivity solutions, delivering highly available and resilient networks (including modern overlay/underlay design) across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. Enhance network observability and incident response: drive adoption of advanced monitoring and telemetry tools, ensuring end-to-end visibility into network health. Partner with SRE/Ops teams to support rapid root-cause analysis, incident response processes, and continual performance tuning of the network. Mentor and develop talent: act as a player-coach for the global network engineering community, sharing expertise, guiding senior engineers and architects, and raising the bar for design quality, documentation, and operational excellence in network engineering. Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Network Engineering, or related field (or equivalent professional experience). 10+ years of experience in network engineering and architecture roles, with a track record of designing and delivering large-scale, enterprise network solutions (global or multi-site environments). Deep expertise in core networking concepts – strong understanding of IP networking fundamentals including routing protocols, switching, network segmentation, overlays/underlays, load balancing, DNS/DHCP, firewall policy concepts, and network observability practices. Hands-on experience with network automation and Infrastructure as Code – proficient in scripting (e.g. Python, Bash) and configuration automation, with experience implementing CI/CD pipelines or declarative configuration management for network changes. Demonstrated ability to lead architecture governance (design reviews, standards councils, or similar) and to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams (security, operations, application engineering) to drive consensus on technical decisions. Strategic mindset and execution – proven experience developing network architecture strategies and translating them into actionable designs and roadmaps, while balancing innovation with risk management and compliance needs. Experience with hybrid and cloud-native networking – familiarity with networking in cloud environments and container-based orchestration platforms (cloud VPC/VNET design, service mesh or similar concepts) and integrating them with on-premises networks. Aptitude for emerging technologies (AI/ML) – exposure to or experience with applying machine learning or AI tools in network operations and design (e.g., AIOps for network performance or automated anomaly detection) and a passion for leveraging new tech to solve networking challenges. Preferred Advanced degree (M.S., Ph.D.) in a relevant technical field. Financial services or regulated industry experience – working knowledge of the rigorous security, compliance, and audit requirements in heavily regulated, mission-critical environments. Experience leading major network transformations – such as implementing software-defined networking, network virtualization, or large-scale network automation initiatives in an enterprise setting. Industry certifications or community involvement – recognition through relevant certifications (network architecture, cloud networking, or security) or active participation in industry forums and best-practice communities. Strong business and communication skills – ability to articulate the value and impact of network architecture decisions to non-technical stakeholders, and to produce clear technical documentation and presentations. For New York, NY Only the salary range for this position is USD$215,000.00 - USD$275,000.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance. Our Benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. Our hybrid work model BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. Guidance on AI use for candidates At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. About BlackRock At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees, and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. This role links GPU computing with networking by making sure communication primitives are carefully developed alongside GPU hardware capabilities. Join our team of engineers developing the software foundation for the largest AI systems globally. What You Will Be Doing Build, implement, and optimize GPU communication kernels that underpin collective and point-to-point operations in large-scale AI systems. Leverage deep knowledge of GPU architecture—thread scheduling, memory hierarchy, execution pipelines—to improve kernel efficiency, minimize latency, and overlap computation with communication. Develop GPU-resident communication primitives and device-side APIs that enable fine-grained, kernel-initiated data movement across nodes and accelerators. Profile and tune GPU kernels end-to-end, identifying bottlenecks at the intersection of compute, memory, and network, and driving targeted optimizations. Collaborate with network software, hardware, and AI framework teams to co-design communication strategies that align with GPU execution patterns and emerging model architectures. Build proofs-of-concept, conduct experiments, and perform quantitative modeling to evaluate and validate new communication strategies before committing them to production. Contribute to the evolution of programming models that expose GPU-aware networking capabilities to application developers. What We Need To See 5+ years of hands-on CUDA programming, including writing and optimizing non-trivial GPU kernels. M.Sc. or equivalent experience in computer science, computer engineering, or a closely related field. Strong understanding of GPU architecture fundamentals: warp scheduling, shared memory, L2 cache, memory coalescing, occupancy tuning, and asynchronous execution. Experience with systems-level C/C++ development in performance-critical environments. Familiarity with GPU data movement mechanisms such as GPUDirect RDMA and GPU-initiated communication. Ability to read and reason about GPU performance profiles (e.g., Nsight Compute, Nsight Systems) and translate observations into actionable optimizations. Strong collaboration skills in a multi-national, interdisciplinary environment. Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd Experience developing or optimizing communication kernels in libraries such as NCCL, NVSHMEM, or similar GPU-aware communication frameworks. Understanding of distributed deep learning parallelism techniques, including data parallelism, tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, expert parallelism, and mixture-of-experts parallelism, and the communication patterns they impose on GPU kernels. Background in RDMA, InfiniBand, high-speed networking, and GPU system topology, including NVLink, NVSwitch, PCIe, and network fabrics, and their impact on communication kernel design. Experience with overlap techniques such as kernel pipelining, persistent kernels, or cooperative groups to hide communication latency behind compute. Proven experience evaluating and optimizing large-scale LLM training or inference workloads, including hands-on work with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorRT-LLM, or vLLM, and familiarity with emerging serving architectures such as disaggregated serving. At NVIDIA, you'll work alongside colleagues who demonstrate deep expertise and innovative thinking in the industry, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in AI and high-performance computing.
